finalText: Migrated all 12 app files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. The only remaining `db.query` call is in `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`, which is explicitly marked as a vendored copy that's overwritten wholesale on every upgrade — left it untouched since editing it would be silently discarded. If that vendor adapter's `db.query` usage still needs addressing, it'd have to happen upstream in legacy-orm itself, or via a wrapper outside the vendor directory.
